to: the killer only, or each party member in the same instance (`party_emit` with `instance`). A cave chest goes to its maker and to each run member on that floor

fields.name: id
fields.description: The chest id: 30 random characters (`randomStr(30)`). Send it with `open_chest`.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The x position of the chest.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The y position of the chest. A PvP chest is 10 below the dead character.

fields.name: chest
fields.description: The sprite of the chest. `drop_something`: `"chest3"`, `"chest4"` (gold x10), `"chest5"` (gold x50) or `"chest6"` (items). `"chest8"`: PvP or hardcore loot. `"chestp"`: an `essenceoflife`. `"cavechest"`: a cave chest. Default `"chest1"`.

fields.name: items
fields.description: The number of item stacks in the chest. A PvP chest counts its PvP items (`pvp_items`).

fields.name: owners
fields.description: The account ids (`owner`) that can open the chest: one per account in the party. Absent only on a cave chest that a run member did not make (`cave_send_chest`).

fields.name: party
fields.description: The party name (the name of the leader). Only on a party chest.

confirm.note: Every emit of `drop` builds the object literally; only the cave form has no `owners`

senders.what: `drop_something`: a monster kill (`issue_monster_award`, each member of a cooperative kill, cavalry `drop_on_hit`).
`drop_something_hardcore`: a PvP kill on a hardcore server. No chest when the dead character loses no item.
`drop_something_pvp`: a PvP kill. No chest when the dead character loses no item.
`drop_one_thing`: the first heal of a ghost (`essenceoflife`), and the `mainframe` command `give spares`. Also a reserved encouragement chest (full inventory), and the maker of a cave chest.
`cave_send_chest`: a cave chest, to the other run members on the floor. Also each chest of a floor, to a member who enters that floor.
